crossRefs.note: Turn us, God of our salvation, and cause your indignation toward us to cease.
Seek Yahweh while he may be found. Call on him while he is near.
Let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts. Let him return to Yahweh, and he will have mercy…
“I have surely heard Ephraim grieving thus, ‘You have chastised me, and I was chastised, as an untrained calf. Turn me…
Surely after that I was turned. I repented. After that I was instructed. I struck my thigh. I was ashamed, yes, even…
“Therefore I will judge you, house of Israel, everyone according to his ways,” says the Lord Yahweh. “Return, and turn…
Tell them, ‘ “As I live,” says the Lord Yahweh, “I have no pleasure in the death of the wicked; but that the wicked…
“Even now the ax lies at the root of the trees. Therefore every tree that doesn’t produce good fruit is cut down, and…
“Repent therefore, and turn again, that your sins may be blotted out, so that there may come times of refreshing from…
if I sharpen my glittering sword, my hand grasps it in judgment; I will take vengeance on my adversaries, and will…
In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan…
For my sword has drunk its fill in the sky. Behold, it will come down on Edom, and on the people of my curse, for…
“Son of man, prophesy, and say, ‘Yahweh says: “A sword! A sword! It is sharpened, and also polished.
It will be to them as a false divination in their sight, who have sworn oaths to them; but he brings iniquity to…

translations.web: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
translations.bsb: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.
translations.kjv: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
translations.asv: If a man turn not, he will whet his sword; He hath bent his bow, and made it ready.
